_comment: Known feature-E2E failures. Each entry: { case, gap, reason }. Shrink-only: a new failure fails CI, and an entry whose case now passes must be removed in the same change.

sales-order.reason: The scheme amount is read-only on the order. The Lite desktop types it (TR_SALE_ORD.cs:11264-11290) and adds it to the advance (:11368), but its day-book row, type 05 to the fixed account 00079 (Ac_Rojmel.cs:19), is absent from the real data for the 7 of 76 orders that carry a scheme amount (web/docs/PLAN-SALESORDER-ROJMEL.md section 2.4); building it would add rows the desktop's data does not have. Old gold and old silver are taken since this change.
